info.title: TheQRCode.io Developer API
info.description:
The authenticated REST API for creating, managing and analysing QR codes.

Authenticate with an API key from the developer console (https://theqrcode.io/console), either as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-API-Key: <key>`. Keys are issued per environment: a `sandbox` key only ever sees sandbox data, and sandbox QR codes do not count against plan limits.

Requires the Developer or Pro plan. Access is evaluated per request, so a lapsed subscription revokes existing keys immediately.

Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`; a 429 additionally carries `Retry-After`.

This document is generated from the same catalog that renders the API reference page, so the two cannot disagree.

post.description:
Create a new QR code

Requires the Developer plan or above.

name.description: Display name for the QR code

type.description: QR code type (url, text, wifi, contact, email, sms, vcard)

content.description: The content to encode in the QR code

color.description: Color settings for the QR code

frame.description: Frame and caption settings. Available on every plan.

style.description: Frame style: square (no frame), rounded, circle, dashed

logo.description: Logo overlay: { enabled, dataUrl, size }. Error correction is raised to level H automatically so the code stays scannable. Available on every plan.

styling.description: Advanced styling: dotsType, cornersSquareType, cornersDotType, backgroundType, gradientDirection, gradientColorStops. Available on every plan.

format.description: Output format: png (default), svg or pdf. Returned in qrImage as a data URL of that type.

isDynamic.description: Whether the QR code can be updated after creation (default: false)

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Epoch ms when the window resets

400.description: Invalid request — see the `error` field for the reason

403.description: The key lacks the required permission, the plan does not include API access, or a plan limit was reached

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Epoch ms when the window resets

Get comprehensive analytics data

Requires the Developer plan or above.

parameters.name: qrCodeId
parameters.description: Specific QR code ID to get analytics for

parameters.name: includeScans
parameters.description: Include individual scan data in response (default: false)

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA time zone for date grouping, e.g. America/Chicago. Omit for UTC and a rolling window; supply it to bucket by that zone's calendar days and measure timeRange in whole local days.
